item.title: MiBeeNvr's Recording Deep-Check and Full-Link Observability
item.description: The nastiest failures in a surveillance pipeline are the ones that never raise an error. A frozen live tile could be a dropped camera, network jitter, or the NVR itself — before v0.12, the available diagnostic tools were reading logs and counting frames. The recording side was worse off: ingest, muxing, and writes all reported success, yet playback would corrupt from some point onward, and the write path never said a word about it.
